attributes.additional_details:
ITS HEARTBREAKING. 
I drive past these poor horses every single day, tethered to a very small space on a very busy main road. No food, no water, no shelter. 
Left in the pouring rain, and the blazing sun.

Thank you very much for reading. I hope together, we can make a change.
attributes.background:
STOP HORSE ABUSE 
We NEED to give horses a safe, happy and healthy lives. 
We NEED to put a stop to horses being tied up on busy roads, with no water, shelter or food.
We NEED to put a stop on them being used for transport. 
We NEED to give them a life they deserve.

rejection.details:
Make keeping horses tethered with no shade, food or drink a specific offence
